title: Confirmed-gloss keyed list (Pass 1 SS3.11 closing note - explicitly NOT a record type)
$comment: VG-1c (Voice-Governance Addendum 2026-07-30 SS4.1 Option A, SS4.2): the entry shape is redefined IN PLACE to match what the mechanism's real data has needed all along - the prior world_term/approved_gloss shape could not validate a single live entry (SS1.1's finding: the runtime dataclass is {category, original, gloss}, and category is load-bearing for the A/B rendering order). Still Facilitator-owned, still deliberately a keyed list rather than a 14th record_type (Pass 1 SS3.11's own ruling, preserved). term_id links an entry to its own term record ONCE that record exists - optional by design: 39 of 87 entries belong to worlds with no term records yet (SS4.4), and the Step-2/Step-3 passes fill it; Rule C (gloss/alias cross-namespace, SS5.5) consumes it when present. sources[] mirrors $defs.source_link's fields inline by hand - validate.py registers no cross-file resolver, so a $ref would not resolve (SS4.2's own correction). sources/reviewer_confirmed_date honestly optional per the S3.1 backfill rule and FLAG-013's render-honestly-empty precedent: the 2026-07-25 project-owner review happened but was not captured as structured evidence at the time.
